title: Idea Spark
goal: Type your own idea. Bytey will ask you questions to help you think.
mascot_lines: Your turn! Tell me YOUR idea.
I will ask you questions about it.
There are no wrong answers here.
When you are ready, click Save my idea!

tier2.rephrase: Just type any idea. Big or small! Bytey will help you think it through.

tier3.nudge: Stuck? Try: 'I want to make a game where ___'.

questions: What is the special part — what makes yours different?
